messages.subject: First orders under the supply agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca,

Now that we're live, we're issuing our first POs: SE-PO-50118 for 4x HX-200-BP booster sets for Calderbridge EfW (required 30 June) and SE-PO-50119 for 30 seal kits. We've applied the 5% tier pricing per Schedule 3. Can you confirm the committed delivery dates?

Regards,
Robert Pearce
Head of Procurement, Stratton Energy plc
